blocks.text: ISTANBUL, Turkey — Several thousand people marched through Istanbul on Sunday to protest a growing crackdown on opposition groups and independent media outlets. The protest was called by the main opposition Yeni Parti days after police raided Sozcu TV, installed a government-appointed trustee, and arrested senior staff members. It was the third such takeover in a year, following similar moves against Tele1, Halk TV, Turkey’s most-watched news channel, and leading digital news website T24. Press freedom has come under sustained pressure over the past decade through prosecutions, digital censorship and government accusations that journalists are spreading “fake news,” prompting criticism from […]...
